name: Snider
source:
"So, you're my Master. I'm Snider.

I was created by converting the famous British Enfield rifle—hailed as the 'last masterpiece of muzzle-loading guns'—into a breech-loading rifle. In other words, if you remodel Enfield, you get me. Interested? Want to give it a try?
Since I'm based on a weapon that was already highly useful, there's no need to go on about my performance, is there?
Now, Master. Since you've awakened me, you're prepared, aren't you? Don't bore me."
